sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Styled tick box
sections.what: Draws a small square box with a border that shows a tick mark when selected. It is dimmed and blocks clicks when disabled.
sections.why: Gives a standard checkbox the app's colors and tick icon.
sections.watch_out: The page must link a text label to the box, or the box has no accessible name.

summary: A styled tick box for on or off choices.
purpose: Lets a user turn an option on or off, or select several items from a list.
why: Likely reason: a styled wrapper around the Radix checkbox, using the app's colors and tick icon. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Step 1: Loads the Radix checkbox and the tick icon. Step 2: Draws the square box with its border and selected colors. Step 3: Shows the tick icon only when the box is checked. Step 4: Makes the part available to other files.
inputs: The checked state, a change function from the page, and any extra attributes.
outputs: A square box that shows a tick when checked, and notifies the page when it is clicked.
risks: The box has no visible label of its own, so the page must supply one or screen readers have no name for it.
debug: If the tick does not appear, check the checked state the page passes in. If clicks change nothing, check that the change function is connected. If the box looks faded, check whether it is disabled.
